channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Alia Bhatt unveils fierce bruised look in Alpha poster; YRF postpones film again, fans say 'flop loading'
item.description: Alia Bhatt's delayed film Alpha will now release on July 10, 2026, after being postponed from its earlier dates in December 2025 and April 2026. YRF has also averted a box-office clash with Salman Khan's Battle of Galwan, though netizens appear unimpressed with Alia and Sharvari's Alpha.

item.title: Gautam Gambhir gives one-line reply to MS Dhoni's post after India's World Cup win
item.description: After India's World Cup victory, a warm social media exchange between MS Dhoni and Gautam Gambhir caught attention. Dhoni congratulated the Indian team on Instagram and shared a playful message for head coach Gambhir, and the coach responded. This comes years after Dhoni and Gambhir's alleged feud following the 2011 WC.

item.title: Malaika Arora cuddles, cozies up with Splitsvilla fame Sorab Bedi amid dating rumours with 19-year Harsh Mehta
item.description: Malaika Arora was recently seen enjoying with Splitsvilla star Sorab Bedi. The clip shows the two laughing and partying together, with fans noticing their strong chemistry. This comes amid dating rumours of Malaika and Harsh.

item.title: Trump says Iran war may end soon after 'very good' call with Putin; urged Russian President to focus on ending Ukraine war
item.description: Trump said he had a call with Putin to discuss the Ukraine war and the Middle East conflict. Trump added that the campaign against Iran could conclude once the country no longer has the capacity to threaten the US, Israel, or its allies, and warned against any attempts to disrupt global energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Pakistan admits to targeting India's aid to Afghanistan, attacks during Ramadan hurting women, children
item.description: India accused Pakistan of targeting its aid to Afghanistan and carrying out air strikes during Ramadan that killed civilians. India's envoy criticised cross-border terrorism without naming Pakistan, while Pakistan's representative responded, effectively acknowledging the allegations.

item.title: Iran import disruption pushes up paraffin wax prices, match industry in TN's Thoothukudi under pressure
item.description: The safety match industry in southern Tamil Nadu, particularly in Thoothukudi, is under pressure after paraffin wax prices surged from ₹80 to around ₹130 per kg due to import disruptions from Iran. The supply slowdown, linked to the ongoing West Asia conflict

item.title: Sensex, Nifty rebound as US indicates Iran war nearing end; crude prices fall
item.description: As of 9.29 am, Sensex added 413 points, or 0.53 per cent, to reach 77,979 and Nifty gained 112 points, or 0.47 per cent to reach 24,140.

item.title: NCERT issues public apology, withdraws Class 8 textbook after row over judiciary chapter
item.description: NCERT issued a public apology and withdrew its Class 8 Social Science textbook Exploring Society: India and Beyond (Part II) after controversy over a chapter discussing the judiciary. The move followed concerns about references to alleged judicial corruption

item.title: Nvidia's NemoClaw: Strategic masterstroke that positions agentic AI as next enterprise operating system
item.description: Nvidia is partnering with Fortune 500 companies like Salesforce, Google, Adobe, and Cisco for early access and integration, positioning NemoClaw as the foundation for enterprise agentic AI. The platform emphasizes security, governance, and transparency, addressing risks associated with autonomous systems.

item.title: Arctic Shockwave: Greenland's mineral alignment and quiet rewiring of global power
item.description: The Arctic's geopolitics is reaching a critical stage, with Greenland becoming a strategic pivot. Canada-Greenland cooperation on critical minerals—like rare earths, lithium, cobalt, and molybdenum—signals a broader contest over resources vital for AI, clean energy, advanced electronics, and defense.
